about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Ricotta and Honey Toast with Roasted Figs and Pistachios
recipes.summary: Thick sourdough toast spread with whipped ricotta, drizzled with honey and topped with pistachios.
steps: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp at the edges.
Whisk the ricotta with the lemon zest and salt until smooth and fluffy.
Brush the toast with the oil, then spread thickly with the ricotta.
Drizzle with the honey and scatter over the pistachios.
notes: Swap the honey for maple syrup if you prefer.

recipes.title: Congee-Style Oat Porridge with Soy Egg and Spring Onion
recipes.summary: Savoury oats cooked in stock, topped with a jammy egg, soy and crisp shallots.
steps: Bring the stock and ginger to a simmer in a saucepan until steaming.
Stir in the oats and cook for 8 minutes, until thick and creamy.
Meanwhile boil the eggs for 6.5 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks jammy, then cool in cold water and peel.
Spoon the porridge into bowls and halve the eggs on top.
Finish with the soy, sesame oil, spring onion and fried shallots.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the whites are fully set. Cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.
Use vegetable stock for a vegetarian version.

recipes.title: Dosa-Style Chickpea Flour Pancakes with Coconut Chutney
recipes.summary: Crisp savoury pancakes from chickpea flour and spices, served with a fresh coconut chutney.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, cumin, turmeric and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter, then stir in the chilli, onion and coriander.
Blitz the coconut, yoghurt and 3 tbsp water until smooth for the chutney, then season with salt.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a little oil. Pour in a ladle of batter and spread thin.
Cook for 2 minutes, until the underside is golden, then flip and cook for 1 minute more until set.
Fry the mustard seeds in a teaspoon of oil until they pop and spoon over the chutney. Serve the pancakes hot.
notes: Vegan if you use a plant-based yoghurt.

recipes.title: Bubble and Squeak Cakes with Poached Egg and Brown Sauce
recipes.summary: Crisp patties of leftover potato and cabbage topped with a runny egg.
steps: Fry the onion and cabbage in half the butter until soft and lightly coloured.
Mix with the mashed potato, flour, worcestershire sauce and seasoning, then shape into 4 patties.
Melt the remaining butter in a frying pan and cook the patties for 4 minutes each side, until deep golden and crisp.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Serve each cake with a poached egg on top and a spoonful of tangy sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Breakfast Burek Rolls
recipes.summary: Flaky filo rolls filled with spinach, feta and egg, baked until golden.

items: 300g frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Soften the onion in the oil until translucent, then cool.
Mix the onion with the spinach, feta and one egg, plus pepper.
Layer two filo sheets, brush with butter, and spoon a line of filling along the long edge. Roll up tightly and coil into a spiral on a lined tray. Repeat with the rest.
Beat the second egg and brush over the rolls, then scatter over the seeds.
Bake for 25 minutes, until deep golden and crisp.
notes: Food safety: bake until the egg in the filling is fully set.

recipes.title: Dill Creme Fraiche Rosti Towers
recipes.summary: Crisp grated potato rosti layered with smoked salmon, creme fraiche and dill.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato in a clean tea towel until dry, then toss with the flour and a good pinch of salt.
Heat the butter and oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Press the potato into four rounds.
Cook for 8 minutes each side, until deep golden and crisp.
Mix the creme fraiche with the dill and lemon zest.
Top each rosti with creme fraiche, salmon and capers.
notes: Food safety: smoked salmon is ready to eat but keep it chilled until serving; avoid in pregnancy.

recipes.title: Oat and Apple Breakfast Cookies
recipes.summary: Soft oat cookies sweetened with apple and a little maple syrup, easy to eat on the go.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a tray.
Mix the apple, peanut butter, maple syrup and egg until combined, then stir in the oats, cinnamon, sultanas and baking powder.
Scoop 12 mounds onto the tray and flatten slightly.
Bake for 15 minutes, until golden at the edges and firm to touch.
notes: Dessert-style snack. Keeps 4 days in a sealed container.

recipes.title: Tomato and Basil Gazpacho with Sherry Vinegar
recipes.summary: A chilled soup of ripe tomatoes, cucumber and capsicum, blitzed until silky.
steps: Blitz the tomato, cucumber, capsicum, garlic, bread and basil until completely smooth.
With the blender running, add the oil and vinegar in a slow stream until the soup is glossy.
Season with salt, then pass through a sieve for a silkier texture if you like.
Chill for at least 2 hours until very cold, and drizzle with olive oil to serve.

recipes.title: White Bean and Rosemary Soup with Garlic Oil
recipes.summary: A creamy blended cannellini soup finished with a sizzling garlic and rosemary oil.
steps: Soften the onion and celery in half the oil until translucent.
Add the beans and stock, then simmer for 15 minutes, until the beans are very soft.
Blend until smooth, loosening with water if too thick, and add the lemon juice.
Warm the remaining oil with the garlic and rosemary until the garlic is just golden.
Ladle the soup into bowls and spoon over the garlic oil.
notes: Food safety: Keep any leftover garlic, herb or chilli oil in the fridge and use it within 4 days.

recipes.title: Sweet Corn Chowder with Chilli and Lime
recipes.summary: A creamy but dairy-free corn soup lifted with fresh lime and a chilli oil finish.
steps: Soften the onion with the paprika in a saucepan until fragrant.
Add the potato, two-thirds of the corn and the stock. Simmer for 15 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the coconut milk and the rest of the corn.
Warm through for 3 minutes, then add the lime juice and salt.
Serve topped with the coriander and a drizzle of chilli oil.
notes: Food safety: Keep any leftover garlic, herb or chilli oil in the fridge and use it within 4 days.

recipes.title: Greek Egg-Lemon Soup with Shredded Chicken
recipes.summary: A silky Greek soup thickened with egg and lemon over soft rice.
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, bay leaf and stock gently for 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and white in the centre.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and discard the onion and bay leaf.
Add the rice to the stock and simmer for 12 minutes, until tender.
Whisk the eggs and lemon juice, then slowly whisk in a ladle of hot stock. Stir the mixture back into the pot off the heat, until the soup turns pale and slightly thickened.
Return the chicken and stir in the dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre and avoid boiling the soup after adding the egg.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Ginger Soup with Toasted Pepitas
recipes.summary: A smooth roasted pumpkin soup with warm ginger and crunchy pumpkin seeds.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the pumpkin and onion in the oil and roast for 30 minutes, until soft and caramelised.
Cook the ginger in a saucepan for 1 minute, add the roast vegetables and stock, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir through most of the coconut cream.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan until they pop.
Serve with a swirl of cream and the seeds.

recipes.title: Miso Mushroom Soup with Soba and Spinach
recipes.summary: A savoury miso broth with mushrooms, buckwheat noodles and wilted spinach.
steps: Simmer the stock and mushrooms for 6 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender.
Cook the soba in boiling water for 4 minutes, until tender, then drain and rinse.
Whisk the miso with a ladle of hot stock until smooth and stir back into the pot with the soy sauce. Do not boil.
Divide the noodles and spinach between bowls and ladle over the soup.
Finish with the spring onion and sesame oil.
notes: Check the soba label if you need it gluten free; many contain wheat.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut and Sweet Potato Soup
recipes.summary: A West African inspired soup of sweet potato, tomato and peanut butter with ginger and chilli.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil until translucent, then stir in the garlic, ginger and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes, until the sweet potato is very soft.
Stir in the peanut butter and blend until smooth.
Season with salt and serve topped with coriander.
notes: Vegan and gluten free. Contains peanuts.

recipes.title: Hearty Lamb and Barley Broth
recipes.summary: A slow-simmered Scottish style soup with lamb, barley and root vegetables.
steps: Brown the lamb in a large pot until deeply coloured on all sides.
Add the onion, leek and thyme and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the stock, barley, bay leaf and vegetables. Simmer for 1 hour, until the lamb and barley are tender.
Skim off any fat, season, and serve in deep bowls.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach 70°C and be tender throughout.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Prawn Soup with Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: A light Vietnamese style broth with lemongrass, lime and prawns.
steps: Simmer the stock with the lemongrass and chilli for 10 minutes to infuse.
Soak the vermicelli in hot water until soft, then drain.
Add the tomato and prawns to the broth and cook for 3 minutes, until the prawns are pink and opaque.
Stir in the fish sauce and lime juice.
Place noodles in bowls, ladle over the soup and scatter with the mint.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque all the way through.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower and Cumin Soup
recipes.summary: A velvety cauliflower soup deepened by roasting and warm cumin.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the cauliflower with half the oil and half the cumin and roast for 25 minutes, until deep golden at the edges.
Soften the onion and garlic with the remaining cumin in a pot for 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend with the tahini until silky and add the lemon juice and salt.

recipes.title: Chilled Cucumber and Yoghurt Soup with Mint
recipes.summary: A cool, refreshing summer soup of cucumber, yoghurt and mint with a walnut crunch.
steps: Blitz the cucumber, yoghurt, garlic, mint, vinegar and water until smooth.
Season with salt and chill for 1 hour, until very cold.
Ladle into bowls and top with the walnuts and a drizzle of oil.

recipes.title: Tomato and Fennel Seafood Soup
recipes.summary: A light tomato broth with white fish and mussels.
steps: Soften the onion with the fennel seeds in the oil until translucent, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the soup tastes rich.
Add the mussels and cover for 3 minutes, until the shells open. Discard any that stay closed.
Slip in the fish and simmer gently for 3 minutes, until it flakes and turns opaque.
Scatter with parsley and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking; discard mussels that do not open.

recipes.title: Spiced Red Lentil and Carrot Soup
recipes.summary: A vibrant Indian style soup of red lentils, carrot and warm spices.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil until translucent, then cook the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the lentils, carrot and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes, until the lentils collapse.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in for a thick texture.
Add the lemon juice and serve with coriander.

recipes.title: Warm Roast Pumpkin and Quinoa Salad with Lemon Tahini
recipes.summary: Roast pumpkin on herby quinoa with a creamy lemon tahini dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the pumpkin and onion in the oil for 30 minutes, until caramelised.
Cook the quinoa in boiling water for 12 minutes, until the germ spirals out, then drain.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and 3 tbsp water until pourable.
Toss quinoa, vegetables, spinach and parsley together and drizzle with the dressing and scatter over the seeds.

recipes.title: Mexican Street Corn and Bean Salad
recipes.summary: A bright Mexican salad of charred corn, beans, tomato and avocado.
steps: Char the corn in a hot dry pan for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until blackened in spots.
Cut the kernels off the cobs.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and salt.
Toss the corn with the beans, tomato, onion and coriander, then fold in the avocado and dressing.

recipes.title: Greek Horiatiki with Whipped Feta
recipes.summary: Classic chunky tomato, cucumber and olive salad on a base of whipped feta.
steps: Blend the feta and yoghurt with 1 tbsp of oil until smooth and whipped.
Toss the tomato, cucumber, onion and olives with the vinegar, remaining oil and oregano.
Spread the feta on a platter and pile the salad on top.

recipes.title: Sicilian Orange, Radish and Olive Salad
recipes.summary: A crisp Sicilian style salad of shaved radish, orange segments and olives.
steps: Shave the radish very thinly and soak in iced water for 10 minutes until curled and crisp, then drain.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, chilli flakes and a pinch of salt.
Toss the radish with the oranges, onion, olives and mint, and dress just before serving.

recipes.title: Som Tam Style Green Mango Salad
recipes.summary: A crunchy sweet, sour and salty salad of green mango, beans and peanuts.
steps: Crush the garlic and chilli in a mortar and pestle until a coarse paste forms.
Add the sugar, fish sauce and lime juice and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Bruise the beans lightly in the dressing, then add the tomato and mango and toss.
Scatter with peanuts and serve at once.
notes: Use 1 chilli for a milder salad.

recipes.title: Bulgur and Pomegranate Salad with Herbs
recipes.summary: A fresh Levantine style grain salad packed with parsley, mint and pomegranate seeds.
steps: Soak the bulgur in 300ml boiling water for 15 minutes, until tender, then fluff and cool.
Fold in the herbs, tomato, spring onion and pomegranate.
Dress with the oil, lemon juice and salt and let sit 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Smashed Potato Salad with Mustard Dressing
recipes.summary: Boiled and smashed baby potatoes crisped in a hot pan with a punchy wholegrain mustard dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 18 minutes, until a knife slides in easily, then drain.
Press each potato flat with a spoon and fry in 2 tbsp of the oil for 4 minutes each side, until crisp and golden.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and remaining oil.
Toss with the hot potatoes, spring onion, capers and parsley.

recipes.title: Cheesy Cauliflower Mash with Chives
recipes.summary: A lighter creamy mash of cauliflower and potato.
steps: Boil the cauliflower and potato for 15 minutes, until very tender, then drain well.
Mash with the butter, milk and cheddar until smooth.
Season and stir through the chives.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Green Beans with Almonds
recipes.summary: Blistered green beans tossed with garlic butter and crunchy almonds.
steps: Boil the beans for 3 minutes, until bright green and tender-crisp, then drain.
Melt the butter and cook the almonds and garlic until the garlic is golden.
Toss the beans in the butter with the lemon zest and salt.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice with Pandan and Toasted Coconut
recipes.summary: Fragrant coconut rice, light and creamy, topped with toasted coconut.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Simmer with the coconut milk, water, sugar and salt, covered, for 15 minutes until all liquid is absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan until golden and sprinkle on top.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Carrots with Za'atar and Labneh
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted carrots with fragrant za'atar on tangy labneh.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the carrots with the oil, honey, za'atar and salt.
Roast for 30 minutes, until tender and caramelised at the edges.
Mix the labneh with the lemon juice and spread on a plate.
Pile the carrots on top and scatter with mint.

recipes.title: Crispy Roast Potatoes with Rosemary and Sea Salt
recipes.summary: Fluffy inside, crisp outside roast potatoes scented with rosemary.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and heat the oil in a roasting tin.
Boil the potatoes for 8 minutes, then drain and shake to roughen the edges.
Tip into the hot oil and turn to coat. Roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and crisp.
Add the rosemary and garlic for the last 10 minutes and finish with salt.

recipes.title: Sesame Bok Choy with Garlic and Oyster Sauce
recipes.summary: Quick wok-fried bok choy glazed with garlic and oyster sauce.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Fry the garlic for 15 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the bok choy and 2 tbsp water and toss for 2 minutes, until the stems are just tender.
Stir in the oyster sauce and sesame oil, and finish with sesame seeds.
notes: Use a vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce if preferred.

recipes.title: Braised Red Cabbage with Apple and Caraway
recipes.summary: Sweet and sour slow-braised red cabbage with apple and warm caraway.
steps: Melt the butter and soften the onion with the caraway until translucent.
Add the cabbage, apple, vinegar, sugar, bay leaf and 100ml water.
Cover and braise over low heat for 40 minutes, until very tender and glossy.
Season with salt and a splash more vinegar to balance.

recipes.title: Garlicky Sauteed Spinach with Pine Nuts and Raisins
recipes.summary: A quick Spanish style side of spinach with golden raisins and toasted pine nuts.
steps: Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan until golden, then set aside.
Warm the oil and garlic with the chilli flakes until the garlic is pale gold.
Add the spinach in batches and toss until wilted, then stir in the raisins.
Season and top with the pine nuts.

recipes.title: Blistered Broccolini with Garlic and Sesame
recipes.summary: Blistered broccolini with chilli and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Heat a heavy pan until very hot and add the oil.
Cook the broccolini for 5 minutes, turning, until charred in spots and tender.
Add the chilli and garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon, salt and the sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Peruvian Style Green Aji Sauce
recipes.summary: A creamy green sauce with jalapeno, coriander and lime for chicken, potatoes or eggs.
steps: Blitz everything in a blender until completely smooth.
Taste and add more lime juice or salt until the sauce is bright and balanced.
Season with salt and chill for 30 minutes before serving.
notes: Makes about 300 ml; keeps 5 days refrigerated.

recipes.title: Smoky Roasted Capsicum and Walnut Dip
recipes.summary: A Turkish style dip of roasted capsicum, walnuts and pomegranate molasses.
steps: Blitz the walnuts, breadcrumbs and garlic until crumbly.
Add the capsicum, molasses, cumin and chilli and process until a thick, spoonable paste.
With the motor running, stream in the oil until creamy.
Season with salt and serve with warm bread.

recipes.title: Quick Pickled Red Onions with Lime and Oregano
recipes.summary: Bright pink pickled onions that lift tacos, salads and grain bowls.
steps: Warm the vinegar, water, sugar, salt and oregano until the sugar dissolves.
Pack the onions in a jar, pour over the warm liquid and add the lime juice.
Cool, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
notes: Plus 1 hour pickling; keeps 2 weeks refrigerated.

recipes.title: Tzatziki with Dill and Lemon
recipes.summary: A thick garlicky Greek yoghurt dip with cucumber and lemon.
steps: Stir the yoghurt, cucumber, garlic, dill and lemon juice together until combined.
Season with salt and chill for 30 minutes.
Drizzle with the oil to serve.

recipes.title: Fresh Pineapple and Chilli Salsa
recipes.summary: A tropical sweet and hot salsa for fish, pork and tacos.
steps: Mix everything in a bowl until combined.
Season with salt and rest for 10 minutes until the juices run.
Serve soon after mixing for the freshest crunch.

recipes.title: Peanut Satay Sauce
recipes.summary: A rich, glossy satay sauce for skewers, noodles and vegetables.
steps: Warm the coconut milk with the garlic and sambal oelek in a saucepan for 2 minutes.
Whisk in the peanut butter, soy, sugar and lime juice.
Simmer for 5 minutes, until thick and glossy, adding water to loosen.
notes: Vegan. Use tamari to keep it gluten free.

recipes.title: Salsa Verde with Capers and Anchovy
recipes.summary: A punchy Italian herb sauce for grilled meat, fish and vegetables.
steps: Finely chop the herbs, capers, anchovy and garlic together until almost a paste.
Stir in the mustard, vinegar and oil until loose and glossy.
Season with pepper and rest for 15 minutes.
notes: Plus 15 minutes resting; keeps 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.title: Chimichurri with Oregano and Chilli
recipes.summary: An Argentinian herb sauce, tangy with vinegar and fiery with chilli.
steps: Finely chop the parsley, oregano, garlic and chilli.
Mix with the vinegar, oil and salt.
Rest for 20 minutes until the flavours blend.

recipes.title: Homemade Tomato Chilli Jam
recipes.summary: A sticky, sweet and spicy jam for cheese, burgers and eggs.
steps: Blitz the tomato, chilli, garlic and ginger to a rough purée.
Simmer with the sugar, vinegar and fish sauce for 1 hour, stirring, until thick and glossy and it leaves a trail when a spoon is dragged across the base.
Pour into hot sterilised jars and seal.
notes: Makes about 6 small jars; plus cooling. Keeps 3 months unopened.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Mushroom Sauce
recipes.summary: A rich sauce for steak, chicken or pasta.
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the butter until golden and the liquid evaporates.
Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute, then pour in the wine and bubble until reduced by half.
Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer for 5 minutes, until thickened and season and serve hot.

recipes.title: Miso Ginger Dressing
recipes.summary: A creamy, tangy dressing for noodle bowls and salads.
steps: Whisk all the ingredients until smooth and emulsified.
Taste and adjust with more vinegar if needed.
Shake in a jar before using, as it will separate on standing.
notes: Use maple syrup for a vegan version.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato Harissa Sauce
recipes.summary: A deep, smoky red sauce for eggs, roast vegetables and grilled meats.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the tomato, capsicum, onion and garlic with the oil for 35 minutes, until blistered and soft.
Peel the capsicum, then blend everything with the harissa and cumin until smooth.
Season and simmer for 5 minutes until thick enough to coat a spoon.

recipes.title: Ginger and Spring Onion Oil
recipes.summary: Silky, fragrant oil for noodles, rice and steamed fish.
steps: Mix the spring onion, ginger and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the oil until shimmering and almost smoking, then pour over the mixture until it sizzles.
Stir in the soy sauce once the sizzling stops.

recipes.title: Yoghurt Raita with Roasted Cumin and Mint
recipes.summary: A cooling Indian yoghurt side for curries and spicy rice.
steps: Toast the cumin in a dry pan until fragrant.
Stir the yoghurt, cucumber, mint, cumin and salt together.
Dust with cayenne to serve.

recipes.title: Fried Eggs over Spiced Sweet Potato and Beans
recipes.summary: A hearty one-pan breakfast of crisp sweet potato, beans and runny eggs.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the sweet potato for 12 minutes until tender and golden.
Add the onion and paprika and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the beans to heat through.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs and cover for 4 minutes, until the whites are set.
Top with avocado and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.
